confirmed_findings.title: Canonical merge-control rollout is unsatisfiable for the frozen foundation PR
confirmed_findings.introduced_preexisting: New rollout/configuration interaction; sole-owner CODEOWNERS pre-existing
confirmed_findings.severity_rationale: Blocks safe delivery; this is an availability/governance defect, not a proven unauthorized-merge exploit.
confirmed_findings.confidence_basis: Direct live/source comparison plus GitHub base-owner/self-approval rules supports a blocked normal merge path.
confirmed_findings.reproducible_trigger: Compare main effective required checks to foundation check runs; compare PR author to base CODEOWNERS.
confirmed_findings.expected_behavior: Required checks actually execute; an eligible independent code owner can approve.
confirmed_findings.actual_behavior: Main requires TVM governance/process/application; PR12 emits context. Only rhart696 owns affected paths and rhart696 authored PR12/13. Zero reviews observed.
confirmed_findings.evidence_to_conclusion: Direct live/source comparison plus GitHub base-owner/self-approval rules supports a blocked normal merge path.
confirmed_findings.counterevidence: PR13 emits all three checks; its current non-main base has no effective rules. Public bypass actors are unknown; no merge attempt was made.
confirmed_findings.recommended_correction: Prepare a separately scoped, legitimately authored/reviewed bootstrap change that installs real required checks and an eligible second code owner on the base; preserve no-self-approval and do not manufacture success contexts. Re-pin and review changed candidates.
confirmed_findings.regression_acceptance: An independent eligible reviewer is available; exact required checks run genuine scoped commands at the new reviewed head; deny/allow exercise under separately granted authority.

confirmed_findings.title: Parent canonical updater still pushes directly to protected main
confirmed_findings.introduced_preexisting: Direct-push pattern pre-existing, retained in rewritten PR1 updater
confirmed_findings.severity_rationale: Advertised reference synchronization cannot normally complete under the live PR requirement; potential stale reference, not app deployment or data exposure.
confirmed_findings.confidence_basis: Source operation conflicts with observed PR/review requirement; no-bypass assumption is supplied rather than independently proven.
confirmed_findings.reproducible_trigger: Canonical reference needs to advance; workflow ends with git push origin main.
confirmed_findings.expected_behavior: An update follows reviewed PR policy.
confirmed_findings.actual_behavior: Workflow creates a bot commit on checkout then directly pushes main.
confirmed_findings.evidence_to_conclusion: Source operation conflicts with observed PR/review requirement; no-bypass assumption is supplied rather than independently proven.
confirmed_findings.counterevidence: No update push executed. Integrity checks preserve seven pins; policy already forbids unreviewed direct pushes.
confirmed_findings.recommended_correction: Smallest correction: disable this automatic write job pending a reviewed PR-based updater; retain read-only integrity checks and manual reviewed reference changes.
confirmed_findings.regression_acceptance: No direct protected-main write in updater; seven reference pins unchanged; canonical change arrives through an approved PR.

confirmed_findings.title: Keyboard navigation bypasses the resume decision and removes saved data
confirmed_findings.introduced_preexisting: Pre-existing modal gap; incomplete repair in PR13
confirmed_findings.severity_rationale: A normal keyboard path deletes the sole persistent map without choosing Start fresh; subsequent reload/closure loses recovery.
confirmed_findings.confidence_basis: Original app logic reproduced in font-only fixture; source mutator and remove branch explain result.
confirmed_findings.reproducible_trigger: Seed a valid saved map and welcome-complete flag. Focus Resume, Shift+Tab three times to background Start Session, press Enter.
confirmed_findings.expected_behavior: Background inert until explicit resume/replace choice; existing bytes preserved.
confirmed_findings.actual_behavior: Focus leaves dialog; background Start Session sets canSave and empty state is persisted as removal; storedAfter is null.
confirmed_findings.evidence_to_conclusion: Original app logic reproduced in font-only fixture; source mutator and remove branch explain result.
confirmed_findings.counterevidence: SavedSession remains in memory and can still be restored before page closes; original ordinary resume tests pass. No client data used.
confirmed_findings.recommended_correction: Use a real modal with focus containment/inert background, and guard destructive persistence in the state layer until a deliberate resolution of saved data.
confirmed_findings.regression_acceptance: Keyboard/mouse cannot mutate background while choice pending; Tab/Shift+Tab stay contained; Escape behavior is explicitly safe; reload preserves original bytes until explicit replacement.

confirmed_findings.title: Accepting an incoming shared map leaves a stale resume decision active
confirmed_findings.introduced_preexisting: Pre-existing stale savedSession mechanism retained/exposed by PR13 consent flow
confirmed_findings.severity_rationale: User faces a second conflicting decision that can overwrite or erase the just-loaded map; bounded session integrity issue.
confirmed_findings.confidence_basis: Browser observation matches loadDemo not clearing savedSession and render condition allowing old prompt.
confirmed_findings.reproducible_trigger: Saved map exists; open synthetic ?share=ABCDEF; choose Load session.
confirmed_findings.expected_behavior: Incoming map becomes active and superseded resume state is consumed atomically.
confirmed_findings.actual_behavior: Incoming map is saved while old Resume last session dialog remains visible.
confirmed_findings.evidence_to_conclusion: Browser observation matches loadDemo not clearing savedSession and render condition allowing old prompt.
confirmed_findings.counterevidence: Dismissal path passes existing test; initial shared replacement asks consent; no silent database update.
confirmed_findings.recommended_correction: Resolve savedSession and pendingShared in one explicit replace action; preserve prior bytes until validation and choice complete.
confirmed_findings.regression_acceptance: After accept, only incoming map is active and no stale resume prompt; dismiss retains old map; quota/invalid payload leaves prior data available.

confirmed_findings.title: Shared payload validation stops at the top level
confirmed_findings.introduced_preexisting: Pre-existing loadSession validator; unchanged by PR13
confirmed_findings.severity_rationale: Malformed shared input produces an uncaught UI error; no code execution or disclosure demonstrated.
confirmed_findings.confidence_basis: Reproduction and validation branches agree; shared path bypasses new robust local parser.
confirmed_findings.reproducible_trigger: Synthetic API returns coacheeName string and relationships:[null]; choose Load session.
confirmed_findings.expected_behavior: Reject nested invalid content with visible recovery and preserve current map.
confirmed_findings.actual_behavior: Top-level load accepts it; applySharedSession reads null.name and throws.
confirmed_findings.evidence_to_conclusion: Reproduction and validation branches agree; shared path bypasses new robust local parser.
confirmed_findings.counterevidence: Existing persistent map survived the tested error; network response was synthetic, not a real server payload.
confirmed_findings.recommended_correction: Use a shared bounded parser at every ingress and handle fetch/validation failures visibly; keep original map until validated replacement.
confirmed_findings.regression_acceptance: Null/wrong types/oversize/future schema/duplicate IDs invalid at shared ingress; errors visible, no state loss; valid legacy and versioned data supported deliberately.

confirmed_findings.title: Failed PDF export reports a successful download
confirmed_findings.introduced_preexisting: Pre-existing export hook and completion behavior
confirmed_findings.severity_rationale: Facilitator may close or clear a map believing a recoverable record exists; misleading workflow is material.
confirmed_findings.confidence_basis: Hook catches error and returns normally; caller unconditionally completes.
confirmed_findings.reproducible_trigger: Synthetic resumed map; remove SVG in DOM to force export failure; stub print to record fallback; click Export PDF.
confirmed_findings.expected_behavior: Show error/alternative action and stay on map unless a real export action succeeds.
confirmed_findings.actual_behavior: No download observed; print fallback invoked; UI shows PDF Downloaded.
confirmed_findings.evidence_to_conclusion: Hook catches error and returns normally; caller unconditionally completes.
confirmed_findings.counterevidence: Print may allow a user to save a document; it is not guaranteed and the fixture deliberately did not produce one. Protocol tells facilitators to verify files.
confirmed_findings.recommended_correction: Return an explicit success/failure outcome, separate print fallback state and retain map; add long-note pagination and note-inclusion controls as separate acceptance tasks.
confirmed_findings.regression_acceptance: Injected export failure never claims download or auto-clears; cancellation stays on map; successful download contains required fields and long notes without clipping.

confirmed_findings.title: Work-package verification and evaluation accept nonexistent evidence
confirmed_findings.severity_rationale: Allows unsupported package promotion inside the management record; separate release checks/human review limit impact.
confirmed_findings.confidence_basis: Checker tests nonempty strings but does not resolve transition/verification evidence or validate temporal sequence.
confirmed_findings.reproducible_trigger: Set stage verified/evaluated with passed verification and nonexistent file string; fabricate evaluation text; reverse transition dates.
confirmed_findings.expected_behavior: At minimum resolve required evidence references and reject impossible chronology before promotion.
confirmed_findings.actual_behavior: All four adverse fixtures return an empty error list.
confirmed_findings.evidence_to_conclusion: Checker tests nonempty strings but does not resolve transition/verification evidence or validate temporal sequence.
confirmed_findings.counterevidence: Record stages must remain ordered; requirement full-acceptance and release checks impose additional constraints; truth still requires human appraisal. Not a proven release authorization bypass.
confirmed_findings.recommended_correction: Use typed resolvable artifact/record references, hashes and execution provenance; enforce ordered dates and minimum evaluation schema. Keep human appraisal of relevance and authenticity.
confirmed_findings.regression_acceptance: Missing/unsafe/stale evidence and reversed chronology fail; genuine scoped artifacts pass; placeholders cannot promote evaluated status.
confirmed_findings.human_owner_role: Governance tooling maintainer and evaluation lead

confirmed_findings.title: Current audit no longer reproduces zero production findings
confirmed_findings.introduced_preexisting: Pre-existing source-map-js1.2.1 remains; advisory data changed since supplied audit
confirmed_findings.severity_rationale: Current CI audit gate fails and remediation evidence is stale; project-specific exploit path unproven so advisory high is not automatically review High.
confirmed_findings.confidence_basis: Lockfile path and advisory affected range agree; patched1.2.2 exists.
confirmed_findings.reproducible_trigger: Run current npm audit --package-lock-only --omit=dev on frozen candidate lockfile.
confirmed_findings.expected_behavior: Current disposition for all applicable findings and a reproducible release inventory.
confirmed_findings.actual_behavior: One high production affected entry source-map-js1.2.1; six high full entries; full SBOM ESBOMPROBLEMS.
confirmed_findings.evidence_to_conclusion: Lockfile path and advisory affected range agree; patched1.2.2 exists.
confirmed_findings.counterevidence: No attacker-controlled indexed-source-map consumption demonstrated in TVM. Five other full entries are one dev braces chain. Older zero audit may have been accurate then.
confirmed_findings.recommended_correction: Implementation agent should propose compatible source-map-js update and rerun audit/build/regressions; separately resolve optional SBOM mismatch and obtain time-bound dev-risk disposition. No dependency changed in this review.
confirmed_findings.regression_acceptance: Current production high gate passes or a separately authorized applicable disposition exists; full inventory generated or explicitly reconciled; no blind major downgrade.

confirmed_findings.title: Checked-in sharing policy does not restrict reads to possession of a share code
confirmed_findings.introduced_preexisting: Pre-existing source SQL; explicitly documented open limitation
confirmed_findings.severity_rationale: If deployed with anonymous SELECT grants, any anon consumer can list all unexpired sensitive maps; serious confidentiality exposure under a concrete condition.
confirmed_findings.confidence_basis: SQL predicate contains no identity/capability condition; current client filters do not add trusted authorization.
confirmed_findings.reproducible_trigger: In isolated staging with these policies and anon grants, omit the client .eq filter and select unexpired rows. This review did not execute that query.
confirmed_findings.expected_behavior: Server authorizes specific map access independently of client filtering; owner-controlled revocation/retention.
confirmed_findings.actual_behavior: Inspected policy tests only expires_at > now(); insert check true; cleanup optional; no owner/revocation in source.
confirmed_findings.evidence_to_conclusion: SQL predicate contains no identity/capability condition; current client filters do not add trusted authorization.
confirmed_findings.counterevidence: Live schema/grants unknown; SQL may not be deployed; no client data accessed. Proposed server architecture addresses this but is not implemented.
confirmed_findings.recommended_correction: Keep cloud sharing out of client use; qualified reviewer selects local-only or reviewed server authorization architecture; validate synthetic grants/policies/revocation/cleanup and actual disclosure.
confirmed_findings.regression_acceptance: Anon list/read/insert deny; valid owner/share cases allow; wrong/expired/revoked capabilities deny; delete/cleanup/backup semantics evidenced at exact build/config.

readiness.criteria_warrant_and_conditions: Direct-push updater conflicts with main PR control; no independent review evidence. Correct/disable updater and obtain required actual review/checks.
Actual required contexts absent and sole author-codeowner cannot provide independent approval. Resolve legitimate bootstrap and deployment separation first.
Reproduced persistence/export failures and current production audit failure; underlying foundation/base controls unresolved. Repair and rerun at actual retargeted base.
Useful local controls exist, but promotion evidence can be fabricated and operational/deployment binding remains incomplete.

Only isolated synthetic/local exercise: no cloud/client records; explicitly include known failures and verify output; qualified facilitator observes, no efficacy claim. This is not permission for production rehearsal.
Privacy, persistence, accessibility, export, deployment and human approval gates remain unresolved. Critical missing evidence is not waived.
Provisional mechanisms and feasibility protocol are not outcome data or causal/psychometric validation.
